description: Hydropower Inflows at EU MS Level Hydropower inflows dataset derived for the CLINT project CLImate INTelligence: Extreme events detection, attribution and adaptation design using machine learning is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Konstantinos Kavvadias, Kristina Govorukha (E3-Modelling SA). Introduction This dataset was generated to support a model-based assessment of how variability in hydropower inflows affects the long-term European energy system, with a focus on the power sector. It provides machine learning–enhanced daily hydropower inflow time series [MWh] representative of each country's run-of-river (ROR) generation profile. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
